sentence: This project builds mathematical principles that explain why successful artificial intelligence algorithms work and when they can fail.
This project builds a software tool that finds the equations describing how complex physical systems behave under uncertainty.
This project builds materials with careful control at the atomic scale, including twisted stacks of ultrathin materials and flexible two-dimensional materials.
This project uses rail systems as living laboratories to study smart sensing, sustainable materials, and data-driven monitoring for transportation infrastructure.
This project tests whether redox signaling, a type of chemical modification, helps the fruit fly eye adapt to bright light.
This project studies the physical and psychological risks of wearable robots for construction workers and builds a virtual-reality testbed to examine them.
This project builds a network that helps researchers share ways to improve gene editing in plants.
This project builds quantum sensors that hold atoms in microscale boxes made from atomically thin materials.
This project studies how vertical mixing affects the flow of water and the movement of salt in estuaries, using simulations and machine learning.
This project builds a nanosized container from DNA origami that releases molecules when cells exert forces on the protein web around them.
This project designs algorithms that solve bilevel optimization problems in systems with many agents, and proves that the algorithms converge.
This project applies time-resolved cryo-electron microscopy to several biological molecules to show how proteins move during a reaction.
This project develops hands-on modules on cell therapy biomanufacturing, including advanced cell culture, equipment operation, and cleanroom protocols.
This project builds a microfluidic device that rapidly measures electrical properties of single cells, and tests it on whale lung cells.
This project tries to prove when quantum systems have an energy gap above their lowest energy state.
This project studies how a small nematode avoids threats and sleeps to recover from them, using a 13-celled neural circuit.
This project uses computational modeling and simulation in areas such as nanotechnology, drug design and delivery, and biomechanics.
This project brings experts together in a design retreat to map out how robots that interact with people should be designed.
This project develops ways to find critical minerals and recover them from low-grade materials and mine waste.
